'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jim Li DS Agents In The Court''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Informal. Objective Agents; Court/Shada package. Inventory AoBS; scan Agents In The Court.

* '''Player:''' [[Jim Li]]
